//: Mirrors apps/web's compiler options so the two Next apps stay coherent.
The one deliberate difference is the absence of an `@generated/*` path:
nothing under apps/admin is compiler output, and a path alias pointing at a
directory that must never exist would invite someone to create it.
See next.config.ts for why this project is a HARD build gate here, unlike
apps/web where Next's build-time typecheck is switched off.
